home.title: Marketplace Solutions
home.text: This is the modern era. Social media and video marketing have all but taken over the digital landscape. Ahïa Solutions focuses on three things: Web Design, Data Analytics, and Task Automation.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: We form mutually beneficial partnerships with small businesses, providing affordable, cost-effective solutions for web development, analytics, and task automation.

services.title: Web Design
services.text: A custom website that makes your business easy to find, easy to trust, and easy to contact.

services.title: Data Analytics
services.text: Turn your sales and operations data into clear reports that show what's working and where to improve.

services.title: Task Automation
services.text: Automate repetitive tasks like data entry, scheduling, and follow-ups so your team can focus on customers.

about.title: ahïa (ah-he-yuh)
about.story: Ahïa first began as an idea in 2016: a directory of all of the Black-owned businesses in the Raleigh-Durham area. Two years later, [Kori Vernon](https://korivernon.com) was introduced to the business concentration of marketing and picked up a knack for videography. He combined that marketing experience with his passion for videography and problem solving, and launched Ahïa Solutions.
about.title2: Providing Marketplace Solutions for the Modern Era
about.text2:
This is the modern era. Social media and video marketing have all but taken over the digital landscape. Ahïa Solutions focuses on three things: Web Design, Data Analytics, and Task Automation.

Ahïa Solutions provides business solutions for underrepresented and minority-owned businesses, forming mutually beneficial relationships that help them perform in an ever-changing digital landscape.

Our mission is to form mutually beneficial partnerships with small businesses, providing affordable, cost-effective solutions for web development, analytics, and task automation.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: Tell us about your business and what you need. We'll get back to you soon.
